messages:
Lina (Product): Quick sync: we need a concise acceptance checklist for BYOK onboarding that legal, security, and solutions can sign off on. Goal: cut scope for MVP but cover SOC2 evidence and retention asks.
Diego (Eng): Sounds good. Are we thinking per-tenant retention controls or global tiers first?
Lina (Product): Start with global tiers (90/365/999) + a documented path for custom SLAs. Keep UI work for beta.
Ravi (Security): For evidence, require: immutable handshake log, key metadata snapshot (alg, key id, rotation history), export integrity (SHA256), and access audit for the export action.
Nora (Solutions): Customer-facing items: "how to verify" steps and an off-net export option for private deployments. Provide sample curl and verification script.
Amir (Legal): We need standard wording for retention defaults + legal-hold procedures. Also confirm whether we will allow customer-requested shorter retention.
Diego (Eng): Implementation note: handshake-service emits logs. We'll add an append-only writer to object storage and record SHA256 for each bundle. Planning a feature-flagged rollout.
Ravi (Security): Make the object store copy tamper-evident: include a monotonic chain of hashes (prev_hash field) so each record links to prior. Audit should record who requested exports and which keys were present.
Nora (Solutions): Example verification: `./verify_bundle.sh export.tar.gz --expected-hash abc123...` and a one-liner `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keystore/{id}/export?offline=true`
Lina (Product): Acceptance checklist (MVP): 1) Export endpoint with `offline=true` and integrity hash, 2) Immutable evidence storage (hash-chain), 3) Export access log for traceability, 4) Retention tiers documented + contract language drafted, 5) Sample verification script + docs snippets.
Diego (Eng): Timeline: can deliver 1 & 2 in 10 business days behind `byok_evidence_mvp` flag. 3 is quick if we log to the same store. 4/5 need docs/legal input.
Amir (Legal): I'll draft retention clause options and legal-hold appendix. Proposed defaults: 90 / 365 / 999 (999 = indefinite until customer-requested purge).
Ravi (Security): Also require a replay test so the export can reconstruct handshake state. Add test vectors to the checklist.
Nora (Solutions): I'll prepare a customer dry-run playbook and the verification script. Can we include an `--offline-pack` mode for on-prem where export is delivered via signed USB image?
Diego (Eng): We'll support `offline=true` which returns a signed bundle. Delivery mechanism (USB) is on Solutions to coordinate.
DeployBot: deploy-staging: feature-flag `byok_evidence_mvp` enabled for team-stack at 02:00 UTC.
Lina (Product): Action owners: Diego -> PR for sidecar writer + export endpoint (due Fri EOD), Ravi -> evidence definition + test vectors, Amir -> contract text, Nora -> sample scripts and playbook. I'll assemble the one-pager and circulate for signoff.
Amir (Legal): One ask: define data residency impact for exports crossing regions. I will flag it in the clause.
Ravi (Security): Note: rotation metadata must include epoch timestamps and signer IDs.
Diego (Eng): Noted. Will add rotation history in key metadata snapshot.
Lina (Product): Thanks all. If no blockers, aiming for canary next sprint. Reopen in thread if anything pops up. :white_check_mark:
